requiredControls.title: Protect authoritative controls and boot
criteria: Boot succeeds with no Jev credentials or network.
External plugins can subscribe only to granted published kernel information; unauthorized kernel writes fail in broker and contract fixtures.
Inference never authorizes execution, invents test success, changes task ownership, or blocks independent denial/revocation/cancellation handling.

requiredControls.title: NATS and scoped plugin services
criteria: All Agentmux inter-component requests, events, and replies use NATS, including private children on the same host.
Each child receives its own scoped identity, logger, health/configuration, evidence and decision handles; inherited defaults do not enlarge grants.
Standalone Jev plugin works without Agentmux/NATS; Agentmux mode routes through the managed interface without direct-provider bypass.

requiredControls.title: Data, credential, and budget ownership
criteria: Denied sources never reach provider requests, traces, or caches; exported data satisfies source-owner and receiving-organization rules.
Provider credentials remain in the owning runtime secret facility; packages, skills, examples, and logs contain references only.
Concurrency, input/output size, queue time, total deadlines and monetary/usage limits are enforced before and during evaluation.

requiredControls.title: Typed definitions and provider-response validation
criteria: Version schemas, rubrics, fallbacks, provider/model pins and decision policies independently.
Reject missing/extra answers, bad labels/types, invalid probability distributions, mismatched score legends, and unexpected resolved models.
Distinguish unknown, denied, partial, invalid, canceled and unavailable from negative semantic answers; no inherited generic confidence threshold.

requiredControls.title: Freshness, repeated requests, and recovery
criteria: Evaluation identity binds actor/project, exact evidence revisions, candidate order, question/rubric, concrete model and policy; changed inputs cannot reuse stale advice.
Retrieving a stored decision does not reuse execution permission; recheck grants and state before effects.
Timeout/retry/cancel results do not assert that provider work or billing stopped; count every attempt without repeating external tool execution.

requiredControls.title: Evidence completeness and expansion
criteria: Source references bind immutable content/version and visibility; coverage explicitly records excluded, unreadable, truncated and canceled candidates.
Readers resolve actual allowed roots and symlinks before opening files; forbidden evidence does not reach hosted classification.
Required instructions, critical errors, warnings, contradictory evidence and unresolved obligations survive selection; authorized users can retrieve originals.

requiredControls.title: Verified host-specific capabilities
criteria: Separate tested package/transport/hook/session/compaction support for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Desktop Chat, and Cowork; unsupported features report advisory-only or unavailable.
MCP tool availability is never treated as interception of every native client action or access to the full native conversation.
Native macOS/Linux and Windows-via-WSL runtime tests stay separate from external vendor tool and client UI compatibility.

requiredControls.title: Independent semantic and skill qualification
criteria: Use reviewed representative positives, hard negatives, missing-option and unknown cases, adversarial source text, and source/version conflicts; keep test labels outside inference input.
For each enabled definition set explicit per-class error, essential-evidence recall and abstention/coverage targets before evaluating the untouched final holdout.
Skill validation includes suite-wide discovery and paired ordinary-workflow/tools-only/tools-plus-skill runs on actual target hosts; mock/schema success is reported separately from live quality.

requiredControls.title: Honest economics and observability
criteria: Record Jev and downstream usage separately, attempts/retries, queue/network latency, cached billing, expansion and rework per accepted outcome; missing billing remains unknown.
Do not sum overlapping catalog benefits, equate fewer downstream tokens with lower total cost, or treat replay as evidence of unobserved counterfactual outcomes.
Authorized decision-record replay and additional dashboard viewers reuse existing records without more inference; raw evidence has separate access/retention controls.

requiredControls.title: Federation and source-owner restrictions
criteria: Origin retains final task acceptance; receiver owns delegated execution; delivery, acceptance, completion and final approval remain distinct.
Lost acceptance replies and accepted disconnected work retain reservation; reconnect/replay never silently creates a second execution.
Queries and typed answers have their own disclosure policies; allowed transfer to a hub does not automatically allow onward model-provider export.

requiredControls.title: Industrial engineering support boundary
criteria: Declare and test exact vendor/tool/version/environment/artifact combinations; unsupported Windows engineering applications are not implied to work from Linux or WSL.
Use exported records, simulations or actual approved vendor-tool evidence; semantic similarity does not prove type/address/unit compatibility or part interchangeability.
No Jev judgment performs real-time control, grants device operations, certifies safety, fabricates commissioning observations, or signs equipment acceptance.

requiredControls.title: Release and deployment verification
criteria: Publish supported-host/OS matrix and per-capability activation status; retain deterministic operation when optional Jev is unavailable.
Verify scoped uninstall/update/rollback, package version compatibility, failure diagnostics, secret redaction and recovery across restart.
Reconfirm current provider limits, terms, billing/data-processing arrangement and selected model availability; do not market local/air-gapped Jev or default zero retention without evidence.

Filenames, byte counts, SHA-256 hashes, JSON pointers and verbatim sourceProposal objects preserve provenance without embedding machine-local paths. Repository phase definitions supersede older phase wording and historical test status.

firstWaveQualification.rule: P09 qualifies supported local-hub modes of all 12 first-wave skills. P10 fully qualifies the three federation skills on actual connected hubs. Remote modes remain disabled before P10; local evidence does not establish federation behavior.

evaluationMethod: Declare the decision, normal deterministic alternative, data scope, owner, unknown/fallback outcomes and measurable target before implementation or spending.

Keep schema/failure/permission tests separate from live semantic accuracy, host behavior, hardware behavior and commercial-provider qualification. Prior synthetic examples establish no production accuracy.

Use representative reviewed positives, hard negatives, none-of-the-above, source/version conflicts, counterevidence and adversarial material. Separate tuning, validation and untouched release sets; prevent label or answer leakage.

Compare ordinary workflow, tools-only and tools-plus-skill using comparable inputs and accepted outcomes. Report class errors, high-confidence errors, coverage/abstention, critical-evidence recall and required-obligation retention.

Record actual Jev plus downstream usage, failed attempts, retries, cache pricing, queue/network time, source expansion and rework. Unknown billing stays unknown. Overlapping records do not yield additive savings.

Run trigger and near-miss tests across the whole skill suite and behavioral tests on every claimed host/version. P09 local qualification of 12 skills does not qualify remote modes of the three P10 skills.

Run required deterministic authority, durability and federation failure fixtures regardless of whether optional semantic decisions are enabled. Capability advertisements, typed facts and model confidence confer no permission.

Enable each evaluated capability explicitly by scope/version. Retain a disable/fallback/rollback path and a reviewed revise/defer/alternative outcome for unsuccessful candidates; never silently erase catalog coverage.

approvedStorageDirection.status: user-approved-direction; implementation and release qualification remain pending
approvedStorageDirection.decision: Prefer NATS JetStream as shared authoritative persistence through scoped domain owners. Streams retain authoritative records/history, KV holds current views/configuration and suitable bounded state, and Object Store holds versioned large artifacts referenced by durable records. SQL, if used for queries, is an optional rebuildable projection rather than the shared source of truth.
approvedStorageDirection.precedence: This approved storage direction supersedes storage alternatives or assumptions in earlier research and planning annotations. Original sourceProposal objects and historical baseline descriptions are preserved unchanged as source evidence; they do not override this current decision.
rationale: NATS already carries all Agentmux-internal communication. Its persistence facilities can retain shared records and scoped projections without requiring a separately authoritative SQL database for each shared workflow.

An authoritative service remains accountable for every command, invariant and record. Broker connectivity, a shared bucket or a replicated copy never grants plugins or remote hubs unrestricted mutation rights.

One preferred persistence family reduces competing sources of truth, while optional SQL query projections can be rebuilt from retained records and versioned snapshots when relational reporting is useful.

allocation.role: Large artifacts under immutable version/digest identities, with authorized references in durable records.
allocation.limit: Ordinary same-name replacement does not retain historical object versions. Upload, record publication, retention and cleanup require explicit crash/recovery handling.

allocation.limit: No independent SQL command authority or dual-writer shared truth. Record the source revision and reconstruction procedure.

transactionalScope: Atomic batch publishing is released in server 2.12; deduplication support was added in 2.12.1 and further batch features in 2.14. It can commit related messages/underlying KV-subject writes inside one stream with supported expected-sequence checks.

This is not a cross-stream, cross-bucket, cross-hub or external-effect transaction. Choose record boundaries explicitly, preserve durable uncertain outcomes and reconcile failures between stores or tools.
Direct multi-subject point-in-time reads were added in 2.11 and require sufficient retained history and the correct snapshot/pagination contract. Ordinary independent KV gets are not that snapshot.

Direct reads may come from lagging replicas/mirrors. Critical commands use authoritative revision checks and the appropriate leader/read path; UI/query projections disclose their revision and freshness.
approvedStorageDirection.federation: Each independently operating hub owns its records and local persistence domain. Mirror/source copying is scoped asynchronous replication, not permission or an all-hub writable object. Accepted and acceptance-unknown work stays reserved through partitions, retention gaps and restoration until explicit reconciliation/reassignment.
approvedStorageDirection.kernel: This storage choice adds no outside kernel write interface. Protected boot and its approved published-status boundary remain unchanged; surrounding owners use scoped NATS services.
